Committee on Zoning, Landmarks, and Building Standards
City Council Meeting
July 15, 2026

ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
Section 1: Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended
by changing all the B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 10-F in the area bounded by
Aline 75 feet north of and parallel to the public alley next south of and parallel to
West 46°" Place; the public alley next east of and parallel to South Wallace
Street; a line 25 feet north of and parallel to the public alley next South of and
parallel to West 46" Place; South Wallace Street
to those of an RS-3 Residential Single Unit (Detached House)

Section 2: This Ordinance shall be in full effect upon passage and publication.

Common Address of Property: 4639-43 S Wallace Street
